name: engineering-safety
description: Engineering Safety: airworthiness directives (FAA, EASA) with applicability and supersession, accident and incident investigations (NTSB, CSB, BFU, BEA link-only) with quoted findings and probable causes, safety recommendations with dated status, PHMSA pipeline incidents and NHTSA ODI defect investigations with linked recalls. Quoted as published; never a verdict, risk score or compliance determination.

query_examples.intent: Which directives applied to this aircraft model on a date
query_examples.semantics: directives whose published applicability names the model and that were effective and not superseded on the date, each with the revision used and its supersession chain; unparsed applicability is 'possibly applicable - see text'; as published, not a compliance determination

query_examples.intent: What have authorities published about this vehicle
query_examples.semantics: directives, investigations with verbatim findings, recommendations with dated status, defect investigations with linked recalls and complaints, each citing its record revision and the reviewable match that connected it; a subject with no records is 'none on record', never 'safe'

query_examples.intent: Which recommendations are addressed to this manufacturer and what is their status
query_examples.semantics: recommendations addressed to the named body with the status published as of the date and the full dated response history

exclusions: consumer product recalls and food/feed notices (Products safety feature, #1916)
risk scores or safety rankings of manufacturers, operators or models
compliance determinations, maintenance advice or advice beyond quoting the required action
mirroring full investigation dockets, media or non-public data
